**Original Category:** 諸宗著述部／三論宗
**Byline:** 宋 遵式述
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A six-fascicle Northern-Song annotated sub-commentary on Sēngzhào's *Zhào lùn* ([KR6m0038](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6m/KR6m0038) T1858) by the Tiāntái master [遵式](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%B5%E5%BC%8F) Zūnshì 遵式 (964–1032). X870 is the most extensive of the *Xù zàngjīng* witnesses to the *Zhàolùn* commentarial tradition and is the principal Tiāntái-school engagement with the *Zhàolùn*. The work integrates Huìdá's preface (with [曉月](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%89%E6%9C%88) Xiǎoyuè's annotation, parallel to [KR6m0043](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6m/KR6m0043) X869) into its overall commentarial frame, then proceeds through the four constituent treatises in order.

**Abstract**

X870 is the principal Tiāntái-school commentary on the *Zhàolùn* tradition and reflects the Northern-Song Tiāntái revival under Sìmíng Zhīlǐ 四明知禮 (960–1028) and Zūnshì himself. Zūnshì's exegesis is doctrinally rigorous and integrates the *Zhàolùn*'s Mādhyamaka doctrine with the mature Tiāntái doctrine of the *yīniàn sānqiān* 一念三千 (three-thousand-realms-in-a-single-thought) and the *sāndì* 三諦 (three truths) of Tiāntái. The work is doctrinally important as the Tiāntái-school appropriation of the pre-Sān-lùn Mādhyamaka tradition, paralleling the Chán appropriation visible in [KR6m0042](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6m/KR6m0042) X868 and [KR6m0043](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6m/KR6m0043) X869.

The integration of Xiǎoyuè's annotation on Huìdá's preface into the opening of X870 is a notable editorial move: Zūnshì appears to have collated the existing Chán-school annotation with his own Tiāntái-school commentary to produce a synthetic pan-school treatment of the *Zhàolùn* preface. The resulting text is one of the most-cited Sòng-period commentarial references on the *Zhàolùn* tradition.

The composition date is conventionally placed in the second decade of the eleventh century, within Zūnshì's main doctrinal-exegetical phase at the Tiāntái-school monasteries of the lower Yangtze.
